text.body: jaṭāvallī vāgīśaprabhṛtistutyaṃ praṇamyāhaṃ gaṇādhipam vāgīśaṃ ca tathā śrīśaṃ varadaṃ jagatāṃ patiḥ 1 krameṇa dvipadaṃ brūyādvyutkrameṇotkrameṇa ca salakṣaṇaṃ sarvasandhau jaṭā sā procyate budhaiḥ 2 asyāḥ pramāṇaṃ prathame prātiśākhye prapāṭhake rephādeśe'pi śabdācca na dhāmetyārṣaśabdataḥ 3 trikrameṣvaṣṭadhāsandhi dvau dvāvādyantayorapi ārṣasaṃjñaṃ sva evātra sandhayonyetvanārṣakāḥ 4 anyatra pañcadhā sandhiḥ tatrāmṛntau tathārṣagau samau varṇasvarau yatra tatraikassandhirārṣakaḥ 5 padadvayaṃ ṣaṭpadañca tathā navapadaṃ vadet svaravarṇā viśeṣe ca viśeṣe trikrame kramāt 6 padatrayaṃ samāruhya trikrame tu sasandhikam avaruhya yathānyāyaṃ punarārohaṇaṃ smṛtam 7 sandhiṣvevavilomeṣu sūtrāddṛṣṭaṃ yadasti vai nyāyādanugṛhādyacca ddṛṣṭāntādyattaducyate 8 sūtrārtthanyāyasaṃbandhabalādyatra viśiṣyate vilome nyāyataḥ prāptā sandhirityabhidhīyate 9 pradhānasya tṛtīyatvantripadaprabhṛtismṛtam ṛcibrāhmaṇavākyeṣu pūrvantripadameva hi 10 tripadaprabhṛtinyāyo lopālopeṣu vidyate tatra sthamanyayuktañcetpūrvadharmo na vidyate 11 gṛhaṇantvekamuddiśya padaṃ vai kriyate yataḥ tadanyatra tu na grāhyaṃ yajjaṭābhimatairiti 12 saṃhitāvadvidhiprāptaṃ bahavo na vadanti yat addhyetāro jaṭākāle tat bāhvādṛtamucyate 13 yatrārṣenudbhutassandhirjaṭāyāmudbhavedyadi tat brāhmaṇāraṇyakoktasandhidṛṣṭāntamucyate 14 tatheyātāṃ brāhmaṇāyetyopetyākṣarasaṃhitā tatrāpi pūrvaprābalyādaikāro'tra na saṃbhavet 15 ṣatve prāpte śakārasya varṇaśiṣṭe tataḥ param nakāraḥ prākṛtastasmācchnathadvṛtramiti sthitam 16 nimittapratiṣedhe tu na nimittabalādvidhiḥ īṅyaśabdatvasaṃkhyāne vidhirna pratiṣedhabhāk 17 yathā punaḥ kṛdhibalānna satvavidhiriṣyate prādhānyātpunarityasya nimittatvātkṛdheriti 18 yatra syānmahisṛjyatthvantatra ṣatvanna pauruṣe ṛvataḥ pratiṣedhācca mahisaptaca darśanāt 19 iḍasparidhirityukte samiśratvaniṣedhakṛt tatreṅyasyāpyanekasyāttathā viśvāyurityapi 20 stomāya jyotirityatra ṣatvaṃsasya na vidyate anavagrahapūrvatvādviddhṛbhāvastathā sati 21 aprasattenniṣedhasya na pratiprasavasmṛtaḥ pratiprasavatā yasya ṣatvantasyai vanānyathā 22 ṭavargātparabhūtasya lasya duśliṣṭatābhavet anyathā cedvirāmācca dvitvā bhāvādviruddhyate 23 anārṣagṛhaṇādyatra prakṛtissaṃhitā vidhau ādyantayorjaṭāyāntu hyārṣatvātprakṛtirbhavet 24 yatvarepau vinānyatra gṛhaṇandṛśyate yathā ṣatvaṇatvādi sarvatra karttavyamanulomavat 25 yasyaivārṣe yatvarepau syātāntasya hi pauruṣe sati svarapare tadvanniṣedho nānyathā bhavet 26 pradhānaṃ vā nimittaṃ vā dvipadagṛhaṇaṃ yadi vyutkrame sarvato grāhyaṃ krame tatraikadeśataḥ 27 yo lope sottarastiṣṭhantyekadhā gṛhaṇantathā ityekamantimo lopo na nimittamavekṣate 28 anvityasya yathā lopassaṃhitāyāntathaiva hi jaṭāyāmapitasyaiva lopo nyasya na kvacit 29 na bhaveddhrasvabhāgdīrghaśliṣṭe'pi prātilomake tathā nimittā satbhāve pragṛhyanna vidhāyakam 30 na nimittātkakārāntaṃ pakārāntañca pauruṣe anuṣṭuptriṣṭubhau śabdāvastvanuṣṭubasītivat 31 udadhītyatra dīrghasya hrasva syādupalakṣakaḥ tathā prapara ityatra hrasvo dīrghopalakṣakaḥ 32 sūtreṣvadṛṣṭaṃ yatkiñcitsūtrāntarabalādvidhiḥ anuktasyāpi ruddhasya mataṃ grahaṇamanyataḥ 33 yathā viprattau mātrokteḥ pāravatyādisammatā pūrvatra tunvosthitaye sarvalopavyaye sthite 34 udaḥ parassalopastu tasminsthāstaṃ bhave sati lopābhāvo makārasya klibantau rājatau pare 35 teṣāmeva prasiddhatvādaviśeṣeṇa sūcitam teṣāmeva vilope'pi nānyeṣāṃ savidhasmṛtaḥ 36 pṛktādapṛkte dīrghaśca guṇo varṇātparaśca saḥ anvārabhyānnamanyañcetyatṛṇatvaṃ prayujyate 37 yasmātpāryādi pūrvatvantathāpi na vadanti hi upūrvasya nakārasya ṇatvaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ 38 pūrvaṃ paścāṭṭakārasya yathāvaṇṇamadarśanāt satvamākārapūrvo'pi yathāgnāstveti darśanāt 39 apyapācchasyāgamasyādapacchiṣṭeti darśanāt anusvāro'pi nityasyātsarvatraikapade sthitaḥ 40 tato'nyassaṃsadaścetisrādyabhāvādanityataḥ punaruktaṃ yataḥ pañcapadamityuttarañca vā 41 pūrvavadbhavati jñeyaṃ sarvatrāpi vicakṣaṇaiḥ saṃhitāvatkramo jñeyo jaṭā ca vikṛtādiṣu 42 ārṣekāryammukhe'nte ca anyatsyādubhayatra hi āyo'dhvaryo kṛto pūrve lopasyādapyasaṃhite 43 lupto yadi bhavedārṣaḥ kriyate nānyathā budhaiḥ asūtriteṣu sthāneṣu pauruṣe yeṣu varttate 44 granthāntare yathā tadvadidaṃ śāstraṃ yadṛcchayā kṛddhyuttare punaśśabdādvilome satvamiṣyate 45 nāddhvarañceti sūtreṇāvagrahastho niṣiddhyate aci pare yathā raṅgaḥ pūrvo hrasvavaducyate 46 hali pare yathā raṅgaḥ pūrvo dīrgho bhavedyadi tathaiva ma-- nītyatra vilome yatvamiṣyate 47 saṃhitāyāmabhāvācca mithunyaṣṭau ca darśanāt na nūnannṛtyanti na hyatyanyaśabde'nya uccakaḥ 48 nakāro dvitvagolakṣyānnaṇatvaṃ prātilomake padākṣarāṅgavarṇānāṃ dvividhā padasaṃhitā 49 iyannānā padayute codyante pañca saṃhitāḥ kakhaporddhvanimittena yatra satvādikaṃ bhavet 50 tatraiva kṣaparaścetsā tadvidhiṃ yāti na kvacit kramyārddhvano bhavatyagre pāpakorpayatīti ca 51 viṣayoṃ'gira ityevāpyagra ityādi lupyate paritvā punara irjāyanno'sya rātīyata smṛtaḥ 52 saptate po anutvagne tvaṃgo māṃścādhirocane citrañca bhavatandṛpsaḥ punaścedotsa aikyataḥ 53 pavasvamvratapāssūrye paro jñe vai punastathā yaḥ prāṇatastathāyurdāḥ prāṇaṃ me mayi kena ca 54 yenāgne'sminthsadhasthe ca vājyaddhvano na lupyate tripadaprabhṛtiṣveva balīyasya niyogatā 55 alopa eva kaṇṭhokteranyayoge'pi sarvadā 56 iti jaṭāvallī samāptā
